name: ghostcursor
description: Private peer-to-peer cursors and annotations for Chromium and Firefox

scripts.build:test: vite build --mode test && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:all && npm run build:test && npm run build:firefox:test && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox-test --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename firefox-test.zip --overwrite-dest && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build:all
scripts.build:firefox: node scripts/clean.mjs dist-firefox && vite build --config vite.firefox.config.ts --mode firefox && vite build --config vite.firefox.config.ts --mode firefox-background && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode firefox
scripts.build:firefox:test: node scripts/clean.mjs dist-firefox-test && vite build --config vite.firefox.config.ts --mode firefox-test && vite build --config vite.firefox.config.ts --mode firefox-background-test && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode firefox-test
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:firefox
scripts.package: npm run build:all && npm run validate:builds && node scripts/package.mjs

author: Prabin Poudel
